clips.title: The story
paras: Elmpaw's Head is a trophy quest rewarding an adventurer for hunting down the formidable beast Elmpaw. The creature's head is traded to an artisan who prepares mounted trophies for wealthy collectors.

Elmpaw's Head marks the conclusion of a hunt against the creature known as Elmpaw. Felling such a beast is regarded as an impressive accomplishment by wilderness trackers and collectors alike, who value tangible proof of victory over dangerous wildlife.

Upon presenting Elmpaw's severed head, the hunter is rewarded directly by an enterprising handler. Rather than letting the remains go to waste, the recipient prepares and mounts the trophy to sell to affluent patrons looking to adorn their mantles with fierce wild prizes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local adventurer or skinner might be interested to hear the story.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, you took down Elmpaw? Very impressive, friend!
Let me give you something in return for your trophy - I know a few collectors who will pay quite well to have this on their mantle once I've prepared it.
